subject: hi-p
title: HI.P.------IF.ST.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 120 (ALT(FT)II-14). HI-P (high purpose) is the subject; IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: POL-DY (political dynamics), ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) and INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From POL-DY: PART (participation). From PART: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From ALT-FT: TR (transformation). From TR: C-HM (composite humanity). From INFO-DE-B: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From SPT-DY: RT-DY-2 (reality dynamics, the second rt.dy. label). From RT-DY-2: APL-DY.
